title: Pokemon TCG Misty's Determination Evolutions 80/108 Regular Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: This Pokémon TCG card features Misty's Determination, a Trainer-Supporter card from the Evolutions set. The card is an uncommon card with a regular finish and is numbered 80/108. It is illustrated by Ken Sugimori and manufactured by Nintendo. This card is perfect for collectors and players of the Pokémon TCG.
